# Opt-in profile 7 dual-PID join

Apply `portico-dovi-join.patch` after the 100 pinned Jellyfin 8.1.3-1 patches and the checked `portico-dovi-profile.patch`. It uses the same MIT libdovi 3.4.0 C ABI, with no additional dependency. The new FFmpeg source is LGPL-2.1-or-later; FFmpeg's source distribution includes that licence. The patch extends `avformat_suggest` so shared/static libavformat has its own libdovi link dependency. A disabled-libdovi MPEGTS object was also compiled: it has neither the join object, option nor libdovi link flags.

The MPEGTS demuxer exposes `merge_dovi` only in libdovi-enabled builds. It defaults false. Enabling it does not invent a relationship: only an actual profile 7 EL PMT descriptor with RPU/EL flags, HDR10 compatibility 6 and an explicit BL dependency PID establishes a pair in that program. It retains the ordinary FFmpeg reader, including `bluray:`. It never assembles loose clips or uses a timestamp-free intermediate pipe.

HEVC parsers recover complete access units from PES fragments. The two queues require exact source PTS, DTS and POC equality. BL NAL bytes remain intact; EL NALs are wrapped as UNSPEC63, and the actual profile 7 RPU is validated by libdovi and retained. No residual is reconstructed or blended into the base picture. The joined stream has profile 7/RPU/BL/EL/compatibility 6 configuration. A later `dovi_profile=mode=2` operation can produce profile 8.1 with an honest EL/FEL drop.

Bounds are 8 MiB per AU or uncompleted parser input, 32 AUs per layer, 32 MiB of queued packet bytes across both layers, plus the bounded parsers and one output AU. Allocation failure, missing clocks, mismatched clocks/POC, invalid/corrupt/wrong-profile RPU, queue overflow, missing partner at EOF, changed PMT content or ambiguous dependency fails the operation. The failed join stays failed after seek; it never refreshes the handle. PMT version-only changes with identical content are accepted. A valid seek clears parser/queue state before consuming the newly selected source position.

The EL remains an admitted input even when FFmpeg maps only the BL output. It emits no independent packet. The codec-context update carries the genuine newly joined DV configuration into stream-info probing and the output BSF. Tests caught and corrected both an unmapped-EL discard and configuration loss during stream-info probing. Callers must treat demux/BSF failure as a source failure; the qualification CLI uses `-xerror`, and conversion must not silently retry a broken source on another GPU.

`ToolchainFacts.DolbyVisionDualLayerJoin` is a separate Hardware-owned private fact, default false. Filter/option presence alone never raises it. Hardware consumes checked MAIN, applies the patch and qualifies the exact bundle with the real dual-PID suite. `DolbyVisionProfile7To81` remains separate: converting an already joined stream does not establish dual-PID joining.

The host suite has20 real transport fixtures: MEL/FEL with reordered/VFR clocks, EL-first delivery, split-PES AUs, unchanged-PMT/version-only update and 192-byte M2TS; twelve terminal refusal cases (missing generic-private DOVI registration or HEVC declaration, PTS, DTS, POC, dependency, missing final EL, corrupt RPU, wrong RPU profile, missing clock, descriptor removal and queue bound); and one source without a descriptor that remains two ordinary streams. All seven positive cases preserve every NAL byte against the official mux oracle and all 24 decoded base frames. They also pass actual FFmpeg CLI join-to-8.1 MP4 conversion with exact source timing apart from any one explicitly recorded MOV origin shift, `dvh1`/profile 8/compatibility 1/noEL, and generated8.1 RPU equality. Source clocks are authored fixture facts, not inferred clocks from Annex B.

Compile `tests/dovi-join-packets.c` against the exact prefix using `cc -std=c11 -O2 -Wall -Wextra -Werror` and `pkg-config --cflags --libs --static libavformat libavcodec libavutil dovi`. Run `scripts/qualify-dovi-join.py --fixtures fixtures/video/dovi-dual-pid --hdr-fixtures fixtures/video/hdr-generated --scratch EMPTY --ffmpeg EXACT_FFMPEG --ffprobe EXACT_FFPROBE --test-binary BINARY`. The build needs MPEGTS/HEVC/MOV demuxers, HEVC/MP4/rawvideo/framemd5 muxers, HEVC parser/decoder, rawvideo encoder, `hevc_mp4toannexb` and `dovi_profile`. Run the script's20 cases on the target runner; cross-compilation alone is not a packet gate. The owned join C object also passed the complete suite with ASAN/UBSAN; FFmpeg and Rust dependencies in that run were uninstrumented.

This is host source/join qualification. Canonical HW1 and other targets, full disc scan/title/version/runtime composition, the helper's PMT/PID publication, remote read/session composition, real encrypted/complex discs and physical playback remain separate required work. One explicit BL/EL pair is supported per demuxer; materially changed PMT content fails closed rather than silently rebinding. Mastered FEL residual imagery and residual reconstruction are not claimed. Generated structural FEL fixtures cannot establish those image properties.

Generic Dolby transport uses private-PES stream type `0x06` for EL/RPU. With the explicit join option enabled, both DOVI registration and an HEVC video descriptor are required before assigning the source HEVC parser; the profile7/compatibility6 dependency still comes from its DOVI descriptor. Absent declarations remain a terminal source-data error, not a guessed codec, hardware failure or relabelled capability. The20-case fixture gate includes this valid generic form and both missing-declaration negatives. Primary authority: https://professional.dolby.com/siteassets/pdfs/dolby-vision-bitstreams-in-mpeg-2-transport-stream-multiplex-v1.2.pdf sections3.1.3 and7.2.2. Exact source clock and RPU/picture validation remain mandatory.
